# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_tax_code.py — do not edit manually
# The light code's step handlers (gui/journal_entry_widgets/te_tax_light_widget.gui), one
# per tax: op 0 one step down, 1 one step up, 2 to the law's very-low rate, 3 to its
# very-high rate. is_valid is the command's own trigger, so the button is enabled exactly
# when the click would change the rate, and its tooltip lists what is missing.

te_tax_light_step_wage_sgui = {
	scope = country
	saved_scopes = { op }
	is_shown = { te_tax_light_in_force = yes }
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
	is_valid = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 0 }
			te_tax_light_can_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 0 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 1 }
			te_tax_light_can_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 1 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 2 }
			te_tax_light_can_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 2 }
		}
		trigger_else_if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 3 }
			te_tax_light_can_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 3 }
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 0 }
			te_tax_light_cmd_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 1 }
			te_tax_light_cmd_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 2 }
			te_tax_light_cmd_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:op scope:op = 3 }
			te_tax_light_cmd_step = { KEY = wage DIR = 3 }
		}
	}
}
